texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 70], "size": 7.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.09000000000000001}]}], "text": "Most people don't know you can sleep your\nway from London to Scotland."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 0.84, 0.18]}}}, "range": [0, 33], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.11000000000000001}]}], "text": "LONDON → SCOTLAND\nWHILE YOU SLEEP"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 58], "size": 7.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.09000000000000001}]}], "text": "The Highlander sleeper leaves London\nEuston every evening."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 58], "size": 7.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.09000000000000001}]}], "text": "You fall asleep in the city and wake up\nto Highland lochs."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 56], "size": 7.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.09000000000000001}]}], "text": "Book the two legs separately and you can\nsave up to 30%."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1, 1, 1]}}}, "range": [0, 57], "size": 7.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.09000000000000001}]}], "text": "Open the app, search code UK20, and get\nan extra 20% off."}
